obsah: Over the weekend Šimon and Čihi rode for Vodárek Transport in the picturesque town of Hulín. The guys' opening act was Zdeněk Izer. The weather was lucky in the truest sense of the word. A spur of a massive storm cloud ended exactly at Hulín, and if the guys had turned left instead of right at the junction, they would have driven straight into rain instead of a beautiful sunny day. We rode a slightly longer and more action-packed version of the exhibition, the spectators were great and we're glad for the praise from the organisers. Hopefully back in Hulín soon.
